news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slips under $86,000 as money rotates into BCH and ZEC
news.summary: Bitcoin matched Monday's high near $87,300 before running into selling, while citcoin cash surged 28% on a CME futures listing and ZEC added 9%.

news.title: The S&P 500 has a 'breadth' problem. Crypto doesn’t.
Bitcoin consolidates near $86,000 as rally narrows and Brent slips below $100
news.summary: Thirty-eight of the 100 CoinDesk 100 constituents were lower on the day, with bitcoin cash up 32% over 24 hours on a CME futures listing.

news.title: BitMEX shuts down: perpetuals pioneer officially closes it doors after 11 years
news.summary: The exchange, co-founded by Arthur Hayes, stopped trading and deposits, but says users can still log in and withdraw funds as its wind-down continues.

news.title: FTX, Alameda-linked wallets send $75 million in ether to Wintermute, onchain data shows
news.summary: Onchain analysts PeckShield and EmberCN say the funds moved to a Wintermute wallet, but neither a sale nor the purpose of the transfer have been confirmed.

news.title: AI agents will soon buy their own computing power and data using stablecoins, according to BlackRock
news.summary: The asset manager sees payments as the nearer-term opportunity, while markets for computing capacity remain at an early stage

news.title: Coinbase users can now borrow USDC against bitcoin at a fixed rate
news.summary: Coinbase now allows users to borrow the USDC stablecoin against their bitcoin at a fixed interest rate and repayment date.

news.title: XRP Ledger retries upgrade that lets banks split payment and compliance duties
news.summary: The upgrade could activate Oct. 5, letting businesses give another account limited powers such as making payments or approving customers without handing over full control.
